svg.title: The Dynamic Bayesian Decision Network
svg.desc: A readable reconstruction of the two-slice decision network. Weather observations update cane dryness across days; forecasts and delivery-related requirements influence burning decisions and their utility. Nodes: Cane dryness; Observed rain, wind, maximum temperature; Rain, wind, temperature forecasts; Burning conditions; Four-day rain and wind forecasts; Advance burning requirements; Amount to burn; Grower size; Current burning requirements; Value of burning; Cane dryness; Observed rain, wind, maximum temperature; Rain, wind, temperature forecasts; Burning conditions; Four-day rain and wind forecasts; Advance burning requirements; Amount to burn; Grower size; Current burning requirements; Value of burning; Next day's cane dryness.
